Lauren / Priyom —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick notes from billing & finance:

1) Net60 is acceptable for this renewal provided we get either:
   - a signed PO covering the full committed amount up front (preferred), or
   - an approved credit memo/finance-run checklist and a single invoice cadence with a short prepay tranche (we'd generally push Net45 otherwise).

2) Invoice recipient switch is standard; we require the new recipient (accounts@bluewave.com) explicitly listed on the PO and a billing contact name + phone/email for collections. Please confirm the exact legal entity (we need EIN or EORI if EU).

3) For EU customers we also need tax evidence (VAT registration or EORI) to map VAT treatment. If they provide W9/W8 forms, we'll route to tax for record creation.

4) For operational handoff, we'll need: PO (final), billing contact, payment term confirmation, and the requested invoice run schedule. Once we have those, I can create the invoice lane and map to the commit in our billing system.

I've attached a short AP checklist that our AR team uses when switching collectors — includes DocuSign link example for signature and fields we require.

Attachments: ap_checklist.csv (CSV, 2KB)
Link: https://docusign.example.com/merge/ABCD-1234

Proposed next step: Priyom, can you ask BlueWave to send the PO with accounts@bluewave.com and the billing contact info, and ask them to include the EIN/EORI or W9/W8? If they insist on Net60, we'll accept with the full PO approach or a 25% prepay + Net45 on the balance.
